story_overview: In a movie theater, Samuel and Nora share an affectionate moment, but tensions soon emerge within their larger group. After the film, serious conversations unfold on the city streets between Nora, Leo, Carlos, and Kenji, revealing underlying conflicts.

The Grand Cinema: Movie theater auditorium with tiered rows of dark red upholstered seats, dark sound-dampening fabric walls, carpeted floors and aisle stairs, and a large white projection screen at the front.
the plush theater seats: High-backed movie theater seats with plush, dark purple-red fabric upholstery.

Samuel and Nora sit side-by-side in the plush theater seats, their hands clasped together. Nora turns her head to gaze at Samuel with a fond smile, while Samuel keeps his eyes fixed forward on the unseen film.
